episodes.title: The Shilo Inn Tragedy: The Cult of Immanuel David | Salt Lake City 1978
episodes.description:
On August 3, 1978, Salt Lake City awoke to an unimaginable tragedy at the downtown Shilo Inn. What led a mother and her seven children to the 11th-floor balcony, leaving only one survivor?

In this video, we dive into the chilling true story of the Immanuel David family. Born Charles David, Immanuel convinced his followers—and his isolated family—that he was a divine figure. Following his sudden suicide, his wife Rachel and their children made a devastating decision two days later that would shock the nation. We explore the timeline of events, the psychology behind Immanuel's control, and the miraculous survival of 15-year-old Rachel David.
